cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Coffee on Sunday? That year apart was good for us. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You used to insist we spend every Saturday together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. We needed the break to stop treating a free afternoon as proof of love.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked pottery this Sunday too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then coffee Monday. Look at us: a whole extra day apart without an emergency meeting.

mechanism: A confidently organizes renewed contact while yielding the date, treating both the past break and present scheduling freedom as evidence of healthy growth.
confusable: Unlike generic optimism, A specifically reframes a rupture as beneficial; borrowed authority makes accepting B independent plans part of A confident reunion management.
comparison: Year apart and pottery scheduling differ from a failed family gathering now reduced to lunch for two.
seedUse: Use D89-a year apart/Saturdays/pottery/Monday and S02-a revising timing as a confident decision.
